feature_mapping.active_vertex: one modeled vertex slot in a latitude-active packed block
feature_mapping.block_probe: one packed latitude-block range visited by a kernel call
feature_mapping.hole_lookup: one HoleArray.ids_of registry lookup after the union box survives
feature_mapping.pip_dispatch: one outer or hole packed-kernel call

latest_recorded_validation.decision: retain the production coefficients in this change; the fitted order is faster on every seed in the cells it changes, but those cells take 0.2-1.8% of fixture queries, so adoption waits for the next shortcut-index rebuild (PERF-10)
latest_recorded_validation.reproduce: make shortcut-calibration, or dispatch benchmark.yml with calibrate_shortcuts=true; then make shortcut-calibration-record

reference_policy.primary_environment: clang C extension with mapped polygon data on GitHub ubuntu-latest
reference_policy.production_updates: reviewed source changes only; calibration artifacts never rewrite coefficients
supporting_environments: clang C extension with in-memory polygon data
numba with mapped and in-memory polygon data
pure-Python fallback with mapped polygon data
reference_policy.validation: fit on a deterministic 75% cell partition; re-order every ambiguous cell the fit never saw, and compare whole public calls on uniform points in the cells that change
reference_policy.when_to_rerun: after a change to the predicate path, the packed kernels or the coefficients, and after a boundary data update; ordering never changes an answer, so CI does not gate on it

structural_limitations: The geometric proxy conservatively charges the outer PIP on points that terminate successfully inside a hole; the runtime does not.
The geometric proxy charges every individual hole in a surviving union box; runtime traversal stops after the first matching hole.

One constant set cannot represent backend, storage, cache, branch, or early kernel termination effects; reports retain residuals and environment provenance instead of forcing those effects into coefficients.
The active_vertex feature uses POLYGON_BLOCK_SIZE slots for a latitude-active block, including a ragged final block, matching the production proxy rather than claiming an exact edge count.
